items.headline: Round of 32 Conclusion
items.body: The final three matches of the Round of 32 take place today, July 3, 2026, determining the last participants for the Round of 16. Defending champions Argentina face Cabo Verde, while Australia plays Egypt and Colombia meets Ghana.

items.headline: Argentina vs Cabo Verde
items.body: Lionel Messi leads Argentina against the tournament surprise, Cabo Verde, at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami. Kickoff is scheduled for 22:00 UTC.

items.headline: Australia vs Egypt
items.body: Australia and Egypt compete for a spot in the next round at AT&T Stadium in Arlington. Both teams are looking to make history with a knockout stage victory.

items.headline: Colombia vs Ghana
items.body: Unbeaten Colombia faces Ghana at Kansas City Stadium in the final match of the day. The winner will advance to the Round of 16.

metadata.venue: Kansas City Stadium, Kansas City, Missouri

items.headline: Round of 16 Advancements
items.body: Teams including France, Brazil, England, Spain, Portugal, and the United States have already secured their spots in the Round of 16. Germany, Croatia, and the Netherlands are among the notable teams eliminated in the previous round.
